name: The Real Receipt
why_it_works: A price feels arbitrary until you see what it buys. An itemized receipt of hours, steps and materials turns the price into simple math the buyer can do themselves, and specific numbers read as honest.

hook.pattern: Frame the process as a receipt with one shocking total on slide one.
examples: The real receipt for one {{product}}: {{total_hours}} hours.
What one {{product}} actually costs us to make.
Itemized: everything that goes into one {{product}}.

craft.notes: Every line item needs a number (hours, coats, days, grams). Style slides like a thermal receipt: monospace font, dotted dividers. Save the total for the first and last slide so it bookends the swipe.

do_not: Round numbers into vague claims like 'tons of hours'
Inflate hours; customers who order will ask
Turn it into a complaint about customers who say it is too expensive
